metadata.title: Vendor Risk Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for assessing, approving, and monitoring risk associated with third‑party vendors without granting system trust, access, or execution authority.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Vendor governance systems, risk assessment platforms, contract management, and supplier compliance tooling.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Solution pattern governing vendor trust decisions under Zero Trust principles.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines vendor profiles, risk ratings, due‑diligence evidence, and contractual constraints as trust‑relevant data.

props.name: nist-controls
props.remarks: Vendor Risk Management implements supply‑chain risk governance and planning controls.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management Practices.

metadata.remarks: Vendor Risk Management governs how third‑party vendors are assessed and approved from a risk perspective. Vendor approval does not imply system access, software trust, deployment authority, or runtime execution permission.

components.title: Vendor Identification and Classification
components.description: Identifies and classifies vendors based on criticality, data access, system interaction, and operational dependency.

techniques.name: Risk Classification
techniques.remarks: Classification of vendors based on potential impact and exposure.

components.title: Vendor Due Diligence and Assessment
components.description: Evaluates vendor security posture, practices, and history prior to onboarding or engagement.

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise
techniques.remarks: Use of compromised or high‑risk vendors as an attack vector.

techniques.name: Security Assessment
techniques.remarks: Assessment of vendor security maturity and risk posture.

components.title: Contractual Risk Controls
components.description: Ensures contracts and agreements include enforceable security, audit, and notification requirements.

techniques.name: Policy Enforcement
techniques.remarks: Use of contractual and policy mechanisms to constrain vendor behavior.

components.title: Ongoing Vendor Risk Monitoring
components.description: Continuously monitors vendor risk posture and responds to changes or incidents.

techniques.name: Risk Monitoring
techniques.remarks: Monitoring of vendor security posture over time.

components.title: Vendor Risk Non‑Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Defines what vendor approval or risk acceptance does not grant or imply.
components.remarks: Vendor approval, acceptable risk ratings, or contractual compliance do not imply system access, software trust, deployability, safety certification, or runtime execution authority.
